status: Prospective. Predictions fixed before any fit.

labels.F2: 1[(a.x)^2 - (b.x)^2 > t], x = z/||z|| on the cell's grid, a, b = principal axes 1-2 of fit x, t = fit median
labels.Kk: 1[cos(k u) > 0], u ~ U[0, 2pi) independent per example, replacing coarse coordinate 0; same u for every k

arms.amp1: AmplitudeEncodingClassifier(d, n_layers=3), one copy, local Z + linear head
arms.amp2: AmplitudeReuploadClassifier(d, k=2, n_layers=3), two copies on separate registers
arms.angle: AngleEncodingClassifier(8, n_qubits=8, n_reuploads=4, Z and ring ZZ readout)
arms.*_ceiling: SVM on the fidelity kernel of the arm's trained final states (ladder L2)
arms.classical: best of logistic and RBF-SVM by inner CV on x (F) or the 8 coordinates (K)
arms.surrogate2: logistic on all homogeneous degree-2 monomials of x, the explicit single-copy class
arms.surrogate4: logistic on all homogeneous degree-4 monomials of x, the explicit two-copy class
arms.fourierD: logistic on cos(ju), sin(ju), j = 1..D, of the planted u (D = 4 and 16)

training: Adam, lr {'amplitude': 0.05, 'angle': 0.05}, batch 32, 20 epochs, cross-entropy, fit split only; no early stopping; no test-dependent choice
hyperparameters: 5-fold stratified inner CV on the fit split, balanced accuracy, grids of the ladder pilot

F4.contrast: (amp2_ceiling - amp1_ceiling) on F4 minus on F2

exploratory: PneumoniaMNIST 16-value cell for F4: reported without a verdict
design_power_check: Synthetic design check before freezing, no real image involved: unit vectors from an anisotropic Gaussian with a shared mean, 3 draws, 300 test examples, analytic ceilings (x.x')^2 and (x.x')^4. Two-copy minus one-copy ceiling on F4: +0.28 at d=8 and n_fit=800, +0.08 at d=16 and n_fit=800, +0.16 at d=16 and n_fit=2000. On F2: -0.03 at d=8, -0.01 at d=16. The F4 predictions are therefore made for the 8-value grids only. The degree-4 feature space grows roughly as d^4, so at d=16 a null result would reflect sample size, not the function class.
verdicts: learnable: CI above 1/2. bounded: CI lower end at or below the bound. positive: paired CI above 0. CIs: cluster bootstrap over seeds, then test examples, 2000 draws.
falsification: A bounded arm whose CI lies above its bound means an extra frequency source or a leak. Fix under a new protocol version, never by editing this one.
